developerPortal.title: Developer Portal
developerPortal.subtitle: A safe frontend slice for client self-service, built only on top of capabilities that already exist in the current client management experience.
developerPortal.currentCapabilitiesSubtitle: These entry points already map to existing client management endpoints and screens.
developerPortal.upcomingTitle: Reserved for the next Stage2 wave
developerPortal.upcomingSubtitle: These cards intentionally stay descriptive until dedicated APIs and permissions are available.
developerPortal.noSpeculationDescription: This developer portal groundwork intentionally avoids speculative API contracts. It only surfaces current client-management capabilities and marks likely next slices as coming soon.
developerPortal.supportedNowSubtitle: Use the existing application pages as the backend-backed workspace for this slice.
developerPortal.currentFlowSubtitle: A lightweight path we can support today without new endpoints.
developerPortal.boundariesSubtitle: These areas should wait for dedicated backend support before wiring the UI.
